content.text:
BeltQueen is now an admin, and you don't need to restart anything.

- **Adding her:** I used the server's live console to add her to the admin list. The server confirmed: *"BeltQueen was added to the admin list... and will be promoted upon joining the game."*
- **Saved:** She's in the server's admin list file, so she'll stay an admin after restarts. That list now has `bear` and `beltqueen`. Factorio stores names in lowercase and ignores capitalisation, so that's expected.
- **When it applies:** Nobody is online right now, so her admin rights will switch on the next time she joins. Your server only lets admins use console commands, so she'll be able to run them from then on.
- **Server status:** It's running normally. Your player whitelist is empty, so the whitelist isn't blocking anyone and she can join without changes.

One small thing: while I was working, I accidentally sent the text `--help` to in-game chat as a server message. It did nothing, but if anyone was watching chat around 23:58, that's where it came from. Sorry about that.

- **Adding her:** I used the server's live console to add her to the admin list. The server confirmed: *"BeltQueen was added to the admin list... and will be promoted upon joining the game."*
- **Saved:** She's in the server's admin list file, so she'll stay an admin after restarts. That list now has `bear` and `beltqueen`. Factorio stores names in lowercase and ignores capitalisation, so that's expected.
- **When it applies:** Nobody is online right now, so her admin rights will switch on the next time she joins. Your server only lets admins use console commands, so she'll be able to run them from then on.
- **Server status:** It's running normally. Your player whitelist is empty, so the whitelist isn't blocking anyone and she can join without changes.

One small thing: while I was working, I accidentally sent the text `--help` to in-game chat as a server message. It did nothing, but if anyone was watching chat around 23:58, that's where it came from. Sorry about that.
